stormy.description: A grey rabbit archer wearing a green cloak, with a small quiver of felted arrows on his back, carrying a wooden bow.

teacher.description: A black-and-white skunk archery teacher wearing brown leather armor and a brown leather cap with a small russet robin's feather tucked into the band, with a small quiver of felted arrows on his back.

rival.description: A brown giant rat tonic-salesman wearing a patched black top hat, a tailored dark coat over a smart buttoned vest with a brass watch chain, and a small bow tie, with a long pink tail.

chip_monk.description: A plump chipmunk monk with reddish-brown fur and dark back stripes and pale cheeks, wearing simple saffron and russet felt monk robes, with a calm, kindly face.

sister.description: A tiny white bunny, Stormy's little sister, wearing yellow felt overalls with a small bandage wrapped around one foot, leaning on a small wooden crutch.

jerboa.description: A sandy-tan desert jerboa with huge ears and long back legs, wearing a chunky cream knitted sweater and matching leg warmers.

ice_elemental.description: A towering monster built of jagged blue-white ice and packed snow, with broad lumpy shoulders, long heavy arms tipped with sharp icicle claws, and a cold angry face with narrow frosty eyes and a jagged mouth. Far larger than Stormy.

bear.description: An enormous brown bear with thick shaggy felted fur, a broad heavy head, small rounded ears, a dark snout, and long dark claws. Far larger than any other character.

skeleton_key.description: A small iron skeleton key with a wooden tag-like handle. A symbol is carved into the handle: sharp lines, a round moon, and a shape like a little door.

tonic_cart.description: A small wooden sales cart on two wheels with a muted red canopy roof and a muted teal body, the painted surfaces lightly worn but a single solid color each, with the wheels, pull-handle, and structural posts left as natural warm wood. The shelves hold assorted tonic wares — small glass bottles, little stoppered vials, ceramic jars, paper-wrapped packets, and small bundles of dried herbs. No text or labels anywhere on the cart.

lantern.description: A small handheld lantern with a square dark-iron frame and pale clear paneled sides, decorated with small felted star and crescent-moon shapes set into the panels. A little ring handle sits on top. The interior is empty when unlit.

healing_herb.description: A small silver-green mountain herb with soft rounded leaves and a tiny warm golden flower at its center.

home.description: A cozy underground rabbit warren room with rounded earthen walls and a small round window. A few wooden toy blocks are scattered on the floor and a little toy drum sits in the corner.

doorway.description: A round wooden warren door set into a grassy hillside, similar to a hobbit hole, with small window boxes on either side holding leafy cabbages and carrot tops.

obstacle_course.description: A training ground with patches of grass broken up by dirt and sand pits, wooden logs poking up out of the ground, nets and ropes hanging from above, and small wooden platforms built into the trees.

archery_range.description: An open grassy clearing with a row of straw targets on wooden stands at one end and a worn shooting line marked in the dirt.

path.description: A simple dirt path through open grassland, with a clear view to the horizon.

grill.description: A small grill with glowing coals, a tree in the background.

town_square.description: A small open square in town with simple felted buildings around the edges and a packed-dirt floor.

graveyard.description: A small graveyard with a few weathered gravestones, a bare spooky tree with no leaves, and a full moon hanging in the sky.

catacombs_path.description: A side view of a set of stone stairs leading down underground into darkness.

catacombs_chamber.description: An underground stone chamber with broken pillars fallen across the floor, narrow ledges along the walls, and dark gaps in the stone. A skeleton key hangs on a string from the ceiling at the center.

stormy_triumphant.description: A close-up view of Stormy striking a triumphant pose, with stone walls dimly visible in the background.

woods.description: A dense forest filled with thick tangled brambles.

sewer.description: A stone tunnel with a channel of gross looking water running down the middle.

desert.description: A vast sandy desert with rolling dunes under a hot sun.

shrine_exterior.description: A marble shrine with a domed roof, set on top of a hill. A stone path leads up to the door, and a full moon hangs in the sky behind it.

shrine_interior.description: The interior of a shrine with cut stone floors and a stone altar in the middle. Bright moonlight filters through the windows.

frozen_land.description: A wide white frozen plain under a dark sky, with rolling snowdrifts, scattered black pine trees, and a storm building on the horizon.

temple.description: A small mountain temple made of pale stone and warm wood, with paper lanterns glowing under snowy eaves.

frozen_camp.description: A small hollow among snow-laden pine trees, with a little pine-branch lean-to and a tiny campfire sheltered from the wind.

snowfield.description: A wind-scoured snowfield with deep drifts, broken tonic glass half-buried in the snow, and distant temple lights ahead.

frozen_stream.description: A narrow icy stream cutting through the snow, with flat dark rocks poking up through the rushing water.

mountain_foot.description: The foot of a steep frozen mountain trail, where the temple lights glow below and the storm clouds press close above.

icy_pass.description: A narrow icy mountain pass with tall blue-white snowbanks and wind blowing loose snow across the path.

bear_ledge.description: A narrow cliffside ledge of packed snow and rock, barely wide enough to pass, with a deep snowy drop below.

ice_wall.description: A sheer glassy wall of blue ice rising straight to the summit, with faint warm lantern light pointing upward.

summit.description: A small frozen mountain summit above the storm clouds, with a patch of glowing silver-green healing herbs growing in a crack in the ice.

avalanche_slope.description: A steep snowy mountainside below the summit, with cracked snowpack, tumbling powder, and the storm roaring around the trail.

"One after another, or all at once. Let's see what you've got."

the_grill.title: Over the Coals
the_grill.text:
The teacher claps Stormy on the shoulder.

"Drill complete - and you skewered lunch while you were at it."

He lifts a sizzling arrow off the coals and slides it across. They eat together in easy silence. After a while, the teacher sets down his food and looks Stormy in the eye.

"Stormy. There's something about your sister."

the_quest.title: The Quest
the_quest.text:
"There is a healing herb that can help her, but it grows only at the temple, far across the frozen land. To get there you'll first need the skeleton key — old iron, hidden somewhere in town. There's a mark on it: a round moon, and a little door. Find the key. Cross the frozen land. Bring back the herb."

Stormy doesn't wait for the teacher to finish. He's already running.

goodbye.text:

He has to come back fast.

"This tonic stops the cold," the rat says. "No more shivering, no more chilly paws!"

the_pitch.text:
The jerboa hops away clutching her bottle. The rat sweeps off his hat for the crowd, then spots Stormy still standing by the cart. His smile drops like a stone in a well.

"Show's over, little rabbit. Scamper off. Important business is happening near my cart."
